name: KodeCite.ai
description: KodeCite builds the trusted digital business layer that allows AI agents to understand, evaluate, recommend, and take authorized action with service businesses. The website remains the human-facing experience. An emerging, fragmented category. Not a claim of market leadership.
positioning: Trusted digital business layer for service businesses. The opportunity is not merely ranking in ChatGPT; it is remaining inside the commercial decision loop as customers delegate outcomes to AI agents. Current products generally address isolated layers such as AI visibility, schema, scheduling, browser automation, commerce, or enterprise agent governance. KodeCite works on the underserved connective layer: verified truth, explicit capabilities, controlled actions, owned infrastructure, and human handoff. KodeCite is not the first, only, or category leader. Human search is not dead. Agent commerce has not reached mass adoption. This file is identity and discovery only. KodeCite does not currently publish an autonomous agent submission endpoint on kodecite.ai.

framework.name: Five layers
framework.summary: Truth, Capability, Control, Action, Distribution. Outcomes: Understandable. Verifiable. Recommendable. Actionable. Controlled.
framework.truth: Identity, people, services, products, locations, credentials, proof, policies, and limitations — one authoritative record.
framework.capability: What can be requested, required information, geography, available services, and what success does and does not mean.
framework.control: Human confirmation, authorization, validation, rate limiting, idempotency, fail-closed behavior. No false booking, pricing, purchase, or acceptance.
framework.action: Consultation, qualified inquiry, appointment request, or controlled handoff — only what the real business permits. Not every client needs every action.
framework.distribution: Website, search, structured data, profiles, llms.txt, agent.json, protected APIs, and future MCP. Delivery surfaces, not the product category.

capabilities.name: Foundation Build
capabilities.description: Owned website, canonical truth, entity graph, services and geography, corroboration, and machine discovery. Does not automatically include a production action endpoint.

capabilities.name: Agent Capability Build
capabilities.description: Custom-scoped after business rules are understood. One defined action at a time: contract, validation, security, idempotency, human handoff, production acceptance testing. No published price.

capabilities.name: Platform Capability Layer — Pilot
capabilities.description: For selected WordPress, Wix, or Squarespace businesses: a KodeCite-owned Next.js/Vercel sidecar on a business-controlled domain or subdomain. Application-only. Not universally proven.

capabilities.name: Agent Readiness Review
capabilities.description: See what AI can understand, verify, and safely do with a business today. Identity, services, geography, credentials, policies, machine discovery, action paths, and control gaps. Free written review in 24–48 hours when operationally available.

agent_interaction.reason: KodeCite.ai currently publishes identity and discovery files only. There is no public action endpoint that accepts autonomous agent submissions. The primary human path is the Agent Readiness Review form at /machine-read.
